rows.ARS:
Deep yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: NOSchal
Exhibition name: Challis Gold
rows.Origin:
Discovered by J. Greensitt (United Kingdom, 1986).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Nostell Priory Rose Gardens in 1986 as 'Challis Gold'.
rows.Bloom: Deep yellow. Mild fragrance. 15 to 20 petals. Medium, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
